metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 3D 회전 ② 오일러 각과 축·각
metadata.description:
같은 각도를 넣었는데 회전 순서를 바꾸면 왜 다른 자세가 나올까요? 이번 시간에는 비행 장면을 보며 오일러 각의 세 회전과 움직이는 축을 구분합니다. 직접 순서를 바꾸고, 짐벌락과 각도 보간이 어려워지는 이유를 확인합니다. 마지막으로 하나의 축과 각도로 회전을 표현하고, 회전벡터의 계산과 주의점을 두 문제로 정리하겠습니다.

실제 게임40%·설명60%, 배경음악 없이 내레이션으로 진행하는 게임수학 Part2 전체 강의입니다.

englishMetadata.title: Game Math Part 2 · 3D Rotation 2: Euler Angles and Axis–Angle
englishMetadata.description:
Why do the same angles produce different orientations when their order changes? We will observe flight and distinguish the three Euler rotations and their moving axes. Then we will change the order and examine gimbal lock and angle interpolation. Finally, we will describe a rotation with one axis and angle, and solve two problems about rotation vectors and their limits.

A full Game Math Part2 lecture with40% actual gameplay and60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Lecture overview
01:14 Euler axes and order
01:52 Moving body axes
03:46 Reverse-order fixed axes
04:29 Rotation order counterexample
05:44 Equivalent Euler representations
06:23 Gimbal lock and aligned axes
07:55 Calculate the singular case
08:31 Short angular differences
09:54 Correct radians wrap code
10:29 Limits of separate angle interpolation
11:55 Axis-angle representation
12:35 Rotation vectors
14:38 Equivalent axis-angle endpoints
15:19 Finite rotations do not add
16:48 Angular velocity and turn history
17:32 Two guided problems
18:12 What to remember
18:41 Membership thanks and programming coaching

🎮 Build games with real programming skills.
